dataset.name: Grupo Lar - Transferencias internas de recursos
dataset.business_domain: Construcción - logística interna de materiales entre almacenes y obras
dataset.grain: One row represents one line of an internal resource transfer inside a transfer voucher (num_comprobante). A voucher can contain several lines (several resources).

dimensions.name: Transfer Voucher
dimensions.description: Unique identifier for each internal resource transfer voucher.

dimensions.name: Transfer Date
dimensions.description: Date when the internal resource transfer occurred.

dimensions.name: Resource
dimensions.description: Identifier for the resource being transferred.

dimensions.name: Resource Description
dimensions.description: Description of the resource being transferred.

dimensions.name: Resource Unit
dimensions.description: Unit of measure for the resource (e.g., bags, m3, kg, gallons, units).

dimensions.name: Origin Location
dimensions.description: Code for the origin location of the transfer.

dimensions.name: Destination Location
dimensions.description: Code for the destination location of the transfer.

candidate_measures.name: Net Value
candidate_measures.description: Net value of the transfer (monto_debe - monto_haber).

ambiguities: The term 'monto_total' is calculated as'monto_debe - monto_haber'. It is important to clarify that this is a derived measure and not stored in the fact table.

validation_questions.question: Should'monto_total' be included as a measure? If so, should it be treated as additive or non-additive?
validation_questions.context: Given the grain of the dataset, summing'monto_total' across multiple rows may not be meaningful as it represents the net value of each individual transfer line.

validation_questions.question: Are there any other fields that should not be summed due to the grain of the dataset?
validation_questions.context: Given the grain, fields like'monto_haber' and'monto_total' should not be summed across multiple rows as they represent individual transfer line values.
